scope: single-treatment clean-only recipe diagnostic replaying the frozen FP8 compute-site mask under INT8
limitations: Historical checkpoint-selection evaluation partition, not a new confirmatory holdout.
One recipe branch with one engine build; no seed or build-population inference.
No continuation gate is applied: this branch isolates node-selection versus numerics rather than authorizing a robustness study.
The shared mask replays FP8 compute-site selection under INT8 numerics; it is not a TensorRT kernel-precision comparison.
A successful recipe repair is baseline engineering evidence, not a new robustness method.
